caption: Live results use the owner note and its properties.
eval: (async()=>{const p = app.plugins.plugins['live-template-results']; app.setting.close(); if (!app.plugins.plugins['templater-obsidian']) await app.plugins.enablePlugin('templater-obsidian'); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; await v.leaf.setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:v.file.path,mode:'source',source:false}}); v.editor.setCursor({line:5,ch:0}); for (let i=0;i<100 && ![...p.editors].some(e=>e.path===v.file.path);i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.folders=''; p.settings.property=''; p.settings.watch='';await p.setEnabled(v.file.path,true); await Promise.all([...p.editors].filter(e=>e.path===v.file.path).map(e=>e.pending)); document.querySelectorAll('.notice-container .notice').forEach(n=>n.remove()); return 'ok';})()

caption: Pro rules enable trusted folders or a Boolean property.
eval: (async()=>{const p = app.plugins.plugins['live-template-results']; app.setting.close(); if (!app.plugins.plugins['templater-obsidian']) await app.plugins.enablePlugin('templater-obsidian'); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; await v.leaf.setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:v.file.path,mode:'source',source:false}}); v.editor.setCursor({line:5,ch:0}); for (let i=0;i<100 && ![...p.editors].some(e=>e.path===v.file.path);i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('live-template-results-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();p.settings.folders='Live Template Results'; p.settings.property='live-results'; p.settings.watch='hours, rate'; await p.saveSettings(); app.setting.open(); app.setting.openTabById('live-template-results'); document.querySelectorAll('.notice-container .notice').forEach(n=>n.remove()); return 'ok';})()
